premise.claim: Every existing e2e suite installs the version under test from scratch, so none can catch an upgrade-only regression where helm upgrade disturbs already-running workloads.
premise.reportedComponent: CI / e2e coverage of the upgrade path
premise.patchedComponent: new suite test/e2e/upgrade + release-test.yml e2e-test-upgrade job
premise.evidence: Coverage premise, not a runtime symptom: the base branch (main @ 97fea1a) ships no upgrade-compatibility suite, and the two motivating regressions (#433 revision-serialization spurious rollout, #439 spurious-rollout/identity-labels) were both MERGED after being found by hand, not by CI. See results/premise.txt.

staticFindings.evidence: specs.go phase-3 settle no longer uses a fixed 3-detector window; it loops on waitQuiesced (two samples settleDuration apart must agree) before the before/after comparison. The misattribution-while-moving concern is addressed; the proposed checkPodMetadataStable wiring was not taken. H1 retained as a regression guard, not a live finding.
upgrade.go restartController (now ~278-282) calls waitControllerRolledOut + waitValidatingWebhookCABundle + waitCRDConversionCABundle, matching waitForUpgradeReady.

install.go teardownFromRelease (~292-298) issues Delete per CRD with no wait-for-NotFound; helm uninstall --wait does not cover CRDs (chart does not own them), so cascading CRD deletion finishes after teardown returns.
staticFindings.round3: Fixed (teardownFromRelease now waits for CRDs NotFound via a listOwnedCRDs loop)

staticFindings.evidence: specs.go phase-4 v1alpha1 pod-churn check (~679-683) compares against phase-1 `before`, not a local pre-annotation baseline like storedSpecDiff does with storedBefore.
staticFindings.round3: Fixed (v1alpha1 spec takes a local baseline via captureAll at annotation time, not phase-1 before)

staticFindings.evidence: install.go requireCleanCluster (~106-108) checks CRDs are registered, not leftover custom resources; narrow: requires a prior failed run whose CRDs were deleted while CRs hung on finalizers.
staticFindings.round3: Still-broken (requireCleanCluster still checks CRDs registered, not leftover CRs; narrow)

staticFindings.evidence: specs.go:282-288 mid-rollout partition check cannot distinguish 'partition removed by upgrade' from 'partition ignored'; the comment acknowledges the ambiguity.
staticFindings.round3: Still-broken (mid-rollout partition ambiguity; comment still acknowledges it; nit)

staticFindings.evidence: snapshot.go checkStillReady (~1003-1026) iterates beforeSnap.ReadyByRole only; a role with no before status entry is never compared.

snapshot.go captureAll (~151) lists RoleBasedGroupList only; the RoleBasedGroupSet root is never captured, so its generation/UID churn across the upgrade is invisible. Capture-path gap (needs a fake controller-runtime client to make runnable; test/e2e has no fake.NewClientBuilder usage), so verified by inspection, not a unit test.
staticFindings.round3: Fixed (captureAll lists RoleBasedGroupSetList; roots share RBGSnapshot, carry Kind, generation compared)

staticFindings.evidence: upgrade.go waitCRDConversionCABundle (~194-208) only asserts the caBundle is found + NotBeEmpty; non-empty != correct, so a stale/wrong bundle still passes the gate. Needs a live cluster to prove the stale-bundle failure mode.
staticFindings.round3: Still-broken (waitCRDConversionCABundle still only found + NotBeEmpty; non-empty != correct; narrow)

staticFindings.evidence: .github/workflows/release-test.yml ~408 comment still says 'no --set overrides' after line 189 added --set controller.features.portAllocator.enabled=true.

liveNote: L3 needs a real kind cluster with no rbgs install + published from/to images: `make test-e2e-upgrade`. Only signal worth adding for F2: after restartController in phase 3, read a v1alpha1 fixture through the conversion webhook and confirm no TLS error while the CRD conversion caBundle is still the pre-restart value. F3/F7 are observable via a back-to-back second `make test-e2e-upgrade` run hitting requireCleanCluster.
